nodes.label: main.go
nodes.description: Entrypoint of the app. Initializes the game state, sets up the UI, and handles user input. Imports the game logic and UI components. Exports the game state and UI events.

nodes.label: game_logic.go
nodes.description: Contains the core game logic. Manages the game state, rules, and AI. Exports functions for moving pieces, checking for check/checkmate, and determining the winner.

nodes.label: ui.go
nodes.description: Handles the UI components and their interactions. Imports the game logic and UI components. Exports the UI state and events.

nodes.label: ai.go
nodes.description: Contains the AI logic. Imports the game logic and UI components. Exports functions for making AI moves.

nodes.label: game_state.sql
nodes.description: Database table for storing the game state. Imports the game logic and UI components. Exports the game state.
